answer: Witnessed Physical Presence Windows. Each identity must periodically solve a challenge whose kernel runs on a tamper-resistant radio module that only responds while physically within a registered location's acoustic bounds, verified by cross-correlating ambient noise signatures (a gale outside a window, a canyon's echo profile) against live samples. A single operator cannot fake presence at scale: each identity requires its own powered device sitting in its own real room, so the attacker pays full hardware, power, and real-estate cost per clone rather than marginal compute.
